notes: s027 σοι is left unrepresented: the ASV's *carest* carries the person and no separate word stands for the dative. Folding it into μέλει's unit remains defensible. Contrast 22:17 and 22:42, where the dative of the impersonal does have an English pronoun and is aligned to it.
s025/s029: the ASV renders οὐδενός non-negatively as *any one*, so rule 69 keeps *not* on the negator rather than emptying it under rule 41.
s033 εἰς is unrepresented because the ASV absorbs it into the predicate *regardest the person*, which is one of the three cases rule 36 allows.
